properties.description: Three of four harnesses were made to LOAD reflow2 from the file the installer writes — OpenCode reports it CONNECTED, Copilot CLI lists it as a workspace server, Claude Code is daily use. VS Code remains unconfirmed and is named as such. THIS IS THE CHECK THE 96-CASE SUITE CANNOT MAKE: those cases assert which FILES are written, and assert nothing about whether any harness reads them.
properties.findings: Run 2026-08-14 on Ubuntu 24 by installing the harnesses (npm, no sudo) into a project set up by tools/reflow2_init.py, then asking each tool what it sees: `opencode mcp list` -> "✓ reflow2 connected", `copilot mcp list` -> "Workspace servers: reflow2 (local)". It also CORRECTED the registry rather than confirming it — `copilot mcp --help` names its sources as ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json and workspace .mcp.json / .github/mcp.json, so Copilot CLI does NOT read .vscode/mcp.json and the entry labelled "Copilot / VS Code" was promising a harness that file does not serve.
properties.name: Three of four harnesses were made to load reflow2 from the file the installer writes
